ideas.name: any warning inside the overnight range
ideas.why: inside the overnight range, prices the overnight session already accepted: two-sided trade where turns rotate

ideas.name: any warning inside the initial balance
ideas.why: after 09:30, still inside the first hour's range: the day has not broken out, and its edges hold

ideas.name: any warning inside the OR30 range
ideas.why: the same with the opening half-hour, after 09:00

ideas.name: any warning inside the prior day's value area
ideas.why: inside yesterday's value area (70% of its volume) price is fair to both sides, so moves there do not run

ideas.name: any warning against a 3-day streak
ideas.why: after three RTH sessions closing the same way, the swing is extended; turns against it have profit-taking behind them
